Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You move when they move, keeping yourself between them and an easy escape.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
A visible enemy within 3 squares when it begins voluntary movement; resolve after it finishes moving.
Duration
Resolve once at the stated trigger; applied conditions follow normal decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill

Follow up to 3 squares toward it without provoking. You must use a legal route; this does not stop its movement or grant an attack.
